research_paper.title: A Shapelet Transform for Time Series Classification

full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: Explain what a shapelet is in time series classification and why it is useful.
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Helped clarify that shapelets are discriminative subsequences that represent class-specific patterns and enable phase-independent similarity detection.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: Verified by reading Section 2.2 of the paper and confirming the definition and distance formulation.

full_llm_interaction_log.purpose: Understanding difference between shapelet tree and shapelet transform
full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: What is the difference between embedded shapelet decision tree and shapelet transform?
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Clarified that the original approach embeds shapelet discovery inside a decision tree, whereas the transform separates feature extraction from classification.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: Confirmed by reviewing Sections 3 and 5.1 where the transform is compared against shapelet tree.

full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: Why does the shapelet transform paper use F-statistic instead of information gain?
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Helped understand that F-statistic compares class-wise distance distributions and works better in multi-class scenarios.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: Cross-checked with Section 3.1 and experimental comparison in Section 5.2.

full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: What is the computational complexity of exhaustive shapelet search?
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Explained that the candidate space is O(m^3) due to all possible subsequences across all lengths.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: Verified from Section 2.2.1 where candidate size is discussed.

full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: How does the paper select the number of shapelets using cross-validation?
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Helped clarify the 5-fold cross-validation strategy used to determine optimal number of shapelets.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: Verified from Section 3.4 where automatic selection strategy is explained.
